requirements_for_materialization: Use streaming or selected parquet shards; do not download entire repositories.
Count tokens locally; upstream token counts use different tokenizers.
Keep source/revision/document hash/URL in provenance sidecars.
Deduplicate globally before splitting; hold out document groups before packing.
Remove benchmark overlaps before training, including SFT and RL test prompts.
Shuffle across shards; never assume the first N rows are representative.
Stop on source exhaustion and report it; never silently repeat data.
Write independent held-out data outside the training token budget.
Publish actual post-filter token counts and achieved source proportions.
